title: Pure X-Saber
summary: Pure X-Saber EARTH Synchro swarm strategy, pairing classic Beast-Warrior and Warrior commanders with modern Terminal World reinforcements. The deck unleashes explosive hand loops and non-stop graveyard revivals to establish oppressive Level 7, 9, and 10 Synchro commanders.

summary.title: Starters
points: X-Saber Pellina tributes itself upon Normal or Special Summon to Special Summon two X-Saber monsters with different names from your Deck, and grants double attacks or direct attacking when used as Synchro Material.

X-Saber Bruno banishes an EARTH monster from hand or GY to Special Summon itself, searches a Saber or Gottoms Spell/Trap on summon, and can Synchro Summon as a Quick Effect during the opponent's turn.
XX-Saber Boggart Knight Special Summons a Level 4 or lower X-Saber monster from your hand upon Normal Summon, immediately assembling Synchro or Link materials.
XX-Saber Faultroll Special Summons itself from hand while you control two or more face-up X-Saber monsters, and revives a Level 4 or lower X-Saber from your GY once per turn.
XX-Saber Darksoul adds an X-Saber monster from your Deck to your hand during the End Phase if it was sent from the field to the GY that turn.

summary.title: Opening: Pellina 1-Card Synchro Swarm
steps: Normal Summon X-Saber Pellina and activate its effect, tributing itself to Special Summon XX-Saber Faultroll and XX-Saber Fulhelmknight (or Airbellum) from your Deck.
Faultroll activates its effect to revive Level 1 Tuner X-Saber Pellina from your GY.
Synchro Summon Level 7 X-Saber Gottoms using Level 6 Faultroll and Level 1 Pellina.
X-Saber Gottoms triggers on summon to add Saber Combination or Gottoms' Emergency Call from Deck to hand.
Activate X-Saber Bruno in hand, banishing an EARTH monster from GY to Special Summon itself and search Saber Hole.
Set Saber Combination and Saber Hole, ready to Synchro Summon Commander Souza on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Commander Souza, Swordmaster is a Level 10 Synchro boss that tributes an X-Saber monster as a Quick Effect during the opponent's turn to destroy a card on the field, and protects itself from destruction by banishing a Saber card from GY.
X-Saber Gottoms is a Level 7 Synchro that searches a Saber or Gottoms Spell/Trap upon summon and can Special Summon itself from GY when the opponent declares an attack.
XX-Saber Hyunlei is a Level 6 Synchro that destroys up to 3 Spell and Trap Cards on the field upon Synchro Summon.
X-Saber Souza tributes an X-Saber monster to gain battle immunity or destroy an opponent monster without damage calculation.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Saber Combination Special Summons an X-Saber monster from your hand or GY whenever an X-Saber arrives from the Extra Deck, and recurs itself when an X-Saber Synchro is destroyed.
Gottoms' Emergency Call is a Normal Trap that Special Summons two X-Saber monsters from either player's GY while you control an X-Saber monster.
Saber Hole is an omni-negating Counter Trap that negates any monster summon or Spell/Trap activation while you control a face-up X-Saber monster.
Saber Reflection reflects effect damage to the opponent and gains LP while searching a Saber or Gottoms card from your Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: M-X-Saber Invoker is Forbidden under the current Advanced Format banlist and is excluded from this list.
